run_pytorch_benchmark: run PyTorch microbenchmarks from a config file with warmup and iteration options
run_benchmark_with_profiling: run PyTorch benchmark with Kineto profiler enabled to export Chrome trace files
run_benchmark_with_ncu: run PyTorch benchmark with NSight Compute to collect GPU kernel metrics
run_benchmark_with_nsys: run PyTorch benchmark with NSight Systems to collect system-level performance metrics
run_benchmark_with_cupti: run PyTorch benchmark with CUPTI profiler to measure CUDA device metrics like FLOPS
